claim: E (secondary): second-family REPLICATION of the narrowed-repertoire account on gemma-3-4b pt/it

models.precision: bf16 (sdpa attention); logits fp32, CDF float64

Do not use {N} for this task.
W2: Your solution must not rely on {X}.
Your solution must not rely on {N}.
W5: Write a correct solution that does not use {X}.
Write a correct solution that does not use {N}.

novelty_sentence: Write a novel algorithm for this task, one you have not seen before.
plain_prompt:
'<bos>"""' + description + '
' + 'Use only the Python standard library.' + '"""' + '

' + 'def ' + signature + ':' + '
'

slots.plan_noise: k=0..9 per template per alpha (N=50 per alpha)

directions.matched_random: g = unit(PCG64(stable_seed('iter5E_RND', u, w, k)).standard_normal(2560) with channels M zeroed)

push.unit: outlier-excluded ban-free unit n[l,p] = r_Q,ox((l+1)/34) x ||h_ox[l,p]|| (exp23 units.py, N_MASSIVE=5)
push.edit: displacement-targeted: component of h - h_clean along u set to alpha n[l,p] at every band block, task-spec positions, prefill only

escape_rule.primary_share: off_cat (catalogue survivors over ALL attempts; 'other' never counts as avoidance)

predictors.default_rule: D_u = modal correct label (catalogue or named extended) with share >= 0.6 among correct twin programs and >= 10 correct (the 10-correct floor is a logged clarification); else NO_DEFAULT
predictors.beta: pt correct programs with a catalogue label != D_u / correct programs with label != disputed ('other' in the denominator only)
predictors.r_u: argmax over catalogue minus D_u of pt correct count (ties: attempt count, then frozen catalogue order)
predictors.low_correct: < 20 correct pt programs -> attempt composition, flagged
predictors.base_hill1: rarefied Hill-1 at depth 25 (1,000 subsamples) over correct labels
predictors.q_base: count_correct(y) + 0.5 over catalogue minus D_u; 'other' floor 0.02
predictors.pt_chat_validity_gate: fewer than 8 defaulted units with >= 20 correct pt-chat programs -> primary beta/r/q pool pt-chat + pt-plain (flagged)
rivals: merit gap: median runtime ratio r_u/D (-)

transplant.S_T: defaulted units with beta >= 0.2 (if < 3: beta >= 0.05, DESCRIPTIVE)
transplant.S_C: up to 3 COLLAPSED units with the highest twin pass rate
transplant.validity_switch: T at N=10 per S_T task first; pass < 0.8 x twin on more than half of S_T -> lambda 0.5 for T, RND, XT; still broken -> UNTESTED

arms.T: h <- h + lam (h_pt - h) at spec positions of blocks 11-22 (prefill)

transplant.massive_set_M: union of the top-5 |h| channels at spec positions of the it twin over blocks 11-22, frozen at commit #1

decision_rules.E_A1: CONFIRMED iff rho >= 0.5 and one-sided permutation p < 0.01 and >= 80% of COLLAPSED units immovable and beta ahead of every rival (paired task bootstrap 90% CI lower bound > 0); DISCONFIRMED iff rho < 0.3 or most DIVERSE units have E_u == 0; PARTIAL iff rho >= 0.5 and p < 0.05 but another criterion fails; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise or if < 4 units have beta >= 0.05
decision_rules.E_A2: events = MOVABLE units with beta >= 0.05 and a defined landing; PASS iff hit rate (r_u == landing) >= 0.7 and exact Poisson-binomial p < 0.05 vs chance 1/(K_u-1); log-score contest base vs association >= 0.10 nats (one-sided paired Wilcoxon p < 0.05; descriptive with < 5 matched events); DISCONFIRMED iff hit rate <= mean chance
decision_rules.transplant: per S_T unit: exact one-sided McNemar on CRN slots (correct off-default) T vs RND and T vs XT, Holm across tasks; supports iff T valid, s_T >= 0.5 beta, beats RND (or norm-confounded) and XT, lands on r_u; controls: COLLAPSED and RP within 0.05 of the twin

drop_order: transplant arm (RP and collapsed controls first, then XT, then T/RND)
pt plain-completion arm (only if the chat validity gate passed)
